description.default: Open a reviewable time-off request with leave type, dates, and reason prefilled. Use for prompts such as 'Request vacation next week' or 'Book time off from August 4 to 12'. Do not use for balance-only questions; use GetLeaveBalance. Pass leaveType, startDate, endDate, and reason from the prompt. Show working days and conflicts, and never submit without user review and confirmation.
